title: Automated binary classification of hazelnut X-ray images: A deep-learning benchmark for quality assessment
abstract: arXiv:2608.11759v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Non-destructive X-ray imaging can reveal internal hazelnut defects that are difficult to detect by external inspection alone; however, automated interpretation remains challenging because of subtle radiographic differences among classes, marked class imbalance, and limited annotated data. Here, we present a benchmark for binary hazelnut quality classification (healthy versus defective) based on 799 segmented single-kernel X-ray images (224 x 224 pixels, grayscale), grouped into 101 acquisition units. Seven single-model configurations and ten probability-aggregation ensembles were evaluated using a group-wise split-rotation protocol across five data splits generated using different random seeds. Decision thresholds were selected on the validation set, and performance was assessed deterministically on validation and test sets. translated_title: 榛子X射线图像的自动化二分类：质量评估的深度学习基准
translated_abstract: 非破坏性X射线成像可以揭示仅通过外部检查难以检测的榛子内部缺陷；然而，由于类别间细微的放射学差异、显著的类别不平衡以及有限的标注数据，自动化解释仍然具有挑战性。在此，我们提出了一个基于799张分割后的单核X射线图像（224×224像素，灰度）的榛子质量二分类（健康与缺陷）基准，这些图像被分为101个采集单元。我们使用组内分割旋转协议，在由不同随机种子生成的五个数据划分上评估了七种单模型配置和十种概率聚合集成方法。决策阈值在验证集上选择，并在验证集和测试集上确定性评估性能。在专家重新评估的标注条件下，二元交叉熵损失的平均概率集成方法表现最佳。
tldr: 本研究提出了一个基于深度学习基准的榛子X射线图像质量二分类方法，通过组内分割旋转协议和概率集成技术有效处理类别不平衡和有限标注数据，实现了健康与缺陷榛子的高精度自动分类。
en_tdlr: This study presents a deep-learning benchmark for binary hazelnut quality classification using X-ray images, leveraging group-wise split-rotation and probability ensembles to address class imbalance and limited data, achieving high-accuracy automated classification.
